name: Pivot
summary: A shedding card game where Up/Down cards set whether next number must be higher or lower.
rules_text: Shuffle Number cards 1-80 into one draw pile and Direction cards (Up, Down, Pivot) into another, or combine them as a single draw pile. Deal equal hands to all players. Start a central discard with one Number card and set initial play direction clockwise. On your turn in current seating order, you may play one card: a Number card is legal only if it respects the last Direction card, meaning higher than last Number if Up is active and lower if Down is active; a Direction card is always legal, Up sets requirement to higher, Down to lower, Pivot reverses the Up/Down requirement. If you have no legal play, draw one card from the draw pile and pass. First player to discard their entire hand wins.
rating_reason: Specific shedding race with defined deck, turn-based
